title: Jazzy Garlicky Norwegian Fish Skillet
description: A quick and flavorful Norwegian dish featuring garlicky fish, aerated with a hint of Shaoxing wine, served on a lazy-susan-spinner for a fun dining experience. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the cod fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cod fillets and cook for 2 minutes on each side.
Add the Shaoxing wine to the skillet and deglaze, scraping up any browned bits.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8 minutes, until the fish is cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and stir in the lemon juice and parsley.
Serve the fish and sauce on a lazy-susan-spinner, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
